value: Context, not a head-to-head comparison. zlib-rs is a full zlib replacement: complete API and C ABI, compression as well as decompression, SIMD code paths, and performance parity with zlib-ng as a goal. cleanflate (this repo's subject) only decompresses, in safe Rust, without SIMD or a C ABI, and was built in three Foundry rounds; the two efforts have different scopes.
